steps.title: Corners travel on ellipses
steps.text: When a cube spins, each corner travels around a circle. Seen from above at an angle, that circle looks like an ellipse (the orange lines). Draw the ellipse first, then place the corners on it for each frame.

steps.title: Spin the cube
steps.text: Draw the cube turning a little more on each frame. Frame 4 leads back into frame 1.
steps.hint: Slide each top corner a little further along the orange ellipse.

quiz.question: As a cube spins, its top corners move along...
quiz.explain: Each corner goes round in a circle, which looks like an ellipse at an angle.

lessons.title: Spinning Can
lessons.summary: The outline stays, the label slides.

steps.title: The label slides
steps.text: When a can spins, its outline doesn't change at all. Only the things on it move: a stripe slides across, fast in the middle and slow near the edges, because it's going around the curve.

steps.title: Slide the stripe
steps.text: Draw the stripe on each frame as it comes round the can.
steps.hint: Small gaps near the edges, big gaps in the middle.

quiz.question: Where does the stripe move fastest across the can?
quiz.explain: In the middle it's moving straight across; at the edges it's moving mostly toward or away from you.

steps.title: Flip!
steps.text: A flipping coin turns from a full circle into a thinner and thinner ellipse, then a thin line when it's edge-on, then back again. Gravity brings it up and down at the same time.

steps.title: Coin shapes
steps.text: Draw the coin as it turns away: a circle, an ellipse, a thin ellipse, then edge-on.
steps.hint: The width stays the same; only the height shrinks.

quiz.question: When the coin is edge-on to you, it looks like...
quiz.explain: You're looking at its thin edge.

steps.title: The backward-wheel trick
steps.text: A spinning wheel looks great until it's too fast. These spokes are 60 degrees apart. The right wheel turns 55 degrees each frame, almost a whole gap, so your eyes think it's going slowly backward! Keep each frame's turn to less than half the gap between spokes, or blur the spokes.

steps.title: Draw the wheel
steps.text: Trace the rim, the hub and the six spokes.
steps.hint: Circles first, then the spokes from the hub out.

steps.title: Turn the wheel
steps.text: Draw the wheel turning a quarter of a gap each frame.
steps.hint: Each spoke moves only a little way round.

quiz.question: To stop a wheel looking like it spins backward, each frame should turn it...
choices: Less than half the gap between spokes
Almost a full gap between spokes
quiz.explain: Small turns read as forward motion.
